question: For the purpose of this task, refer to data found on the Kelley Blue Book website. I'm interested in comparing the following 2023 Honda models: CR-V, HR-V, and Odyssey. Identify the horsepower and cargo volume (cu. ft.) of each vehicle, and then divide the horsepower by the cargo volume. Of the three vehicles, indicate which has the lowest horsepower-to-volume ratio.

Cargo Volume 32.80 cu ft" from result 3. Good.

HR-V: 158 / 55.1 = 2.868... approx 2.87 hp per cu ft.

Odyssey: 280 / 32.8 = 8.536... approx 8.54 hp per cu ft.

Lowest ratio is CR-V with 2.48.

*Lower ratios mean *less* horsepower per cubic‑foot of cargo space.*

## 2023 Honda HR-V Sales near Passaic, NJ
One of the best subcompact SUVs just got better in its newest iteration. The 2023 Honda HR-V is an improvement over its predecessor in terms of visual appeal and overall quality. Thanks to the upgraded suspension, it has a more powerful engine and a smoother ride.
The new HR-V interior and exterior are both sleek and cutting-edge. With its active noise cancellation and multi-link suspension system, this vehicle exceeds expectations in comfort and handling.
All-wheel drive and automatic hill-descent control are standard features on every new HR-V.
The 2023 HR-V has three distinct styles:
*   LX  
*   Sport  
*   EX-L
Visit Garden State Honda near Passaic, NJ, for a test drive of the 2023 Honda HR-V and see how wonderfully it handles and performs.

## Interior Review of the 2023 Honda HR-V
The 2023 HR-modernized V's cabin had the refined and functional 2023 Civic as inspiration.
The driver and front passenger seats are extremely flexible and comfortable. The new HR-V has larger cargo space and a shorter lift-over height, making it simpler to load heavy objects.

## Exterior Review of the 2023 Honda HR-V
The 2023 HR-V sheds its generic former exterior in favor of a more distinctive look.
Taking its cues from the Civic, a larger vehicle, the new HR-V is bigger than its predecessor.
The wheels on the LX are silver, those on the Sport are black (matching the grille, mirror housings, and spoiler), and those on the EX-L are machine-finished alloys with Gloss Shark Gray inlays.
The 2023 HR-V comes in a variety of colors, such as:
*   Platinum White Pearl  
*   Milano Red  
*   Lunar Silver Metallic  
*   Crystal Black Pearl  
*   Modern Steel Metallic  
*   Midnight Amethyst Metallic  
*   Aegean Blue Metallic

## Power and Performance of the 2023 Honda HR-V
All three new HR-V trims share the same engine, a 2.0-liter inline-four without turbocharging.
The 2023 HR-V has 158 horsepower and 138 pound-feet of torque. It has front-wheel drive as standard equipment, while all-wheel drive is an option on every model. With this engine, you can use gas safely.
The HR-V provides a more luxurious ride quality than its price tag suggests, making even the most basic trims comfortable. Because of its satisfying and dependable handling, the HR-V can take curves confidently.
When pushed to its limits, the HR-V displays astonishing swiftness. In addition, the CVT's efficiency is impressive.
Despite criticism that CVTs create a messy acceleration curve when paired with a high-performance engine, Honda's CVT is as smooth as conventional automatic transmission.

## Key Technology Features
*   USB charging ports  
*   7-inch multi-information display  
*   Android Auto™/Apple CarPlay®  
*   All-digital speedometer and tachometer  
*   Body stabilizing seats  
*   Standard 7-inch color touch screen

## Key Safety Features
*   Traffic jam assist  
*   Pretensioners  
*   Anti-lock brakes  
*   Security System  
*   Multiple airbags  
*   Blind-spot monitoring with rear cross-traffic alert  
*   Stability control  
*   Honda Sensing®

## Find Your 2023 Honda HR-V at Garden State Honda
Good news for Passaic, NJ, residents who are waiting for the 2023 Honda HR-V. It is now available at Garden State Honda. Check out our stock, and then stop by our showroom in Clifton, NJ, to test drive a brand-new HR-V.
